author: emilizzle
body:
Hello Avicus Staff, here we are again.

Iron, I understand that you said '2 - 4 months' but really? I have waited 5 months and 19 days, and you have unbanned other people who ended up joining your team who were banned for a lot shorter than what I have been banned for. I believe I have waited out my ban time. I know not to advertise again, I was done with MC and I thought  I had nothing left on Avicus, because BC were about to disband. This was a mistake. To think I was done with minecraft and waste a server I loved playing on if I came back. I honestly have learned 2 lessons, one to not advertise other servers, jokingly or not, and two to not think I'm done and ruin what I loved if I decided to ever come back. I hope you can give me a second chance, and I ask Iron not to deal with this appeal.

Regards

Pantai
